bonus.title: The bonus rule
bonus.intro: In the pilot we use two bonus rules that pay out the same. Your minute points are the same for everyone: 1 point per minute that counted.
bonus.yours_a: Your squad has the rule 'per goal met +20'; the other one is 'weekly budget'.
bonus.yours_b: Your squad has the rule 'weekly budget'; the other one is 'per goal met +20'.
bonus.none: No goal bonus applies right now. Your minute points carry on as usual.
bonus.rule_a: Meet your daily goal and you get 20 extra points, available right away.
bonus.rule_b: On Monday your weekly budget is 140 points. Every day you meet your goal, you secure 20 of them. A missed goal lets 20 of the weekly budget lapse; we never take anything from your available points.
bonus.joker: The joker protects your squad streak, not the goal bonus.
bonus.night: Sessions that start between 01:00 and 04:00 count for points and your daily goal, but without goal bonus.
bonus.exam: On an exam day your daily goal doesn't count. With the 'weekly budget' rule that day quietly drops out of the budget.
bonus.season: The goal bonus stops at the end of the last exam week of your institution, on {date}.
